subject: Changing the y-axis scale in TIF plots

messages.author: f61de5f78c7e0a18
messages.subject: Changing the y-axis scale in TIF plots
parts:
Dear Phil,

I have created two plots depicting the total information function.  These plots share the same information scale (e.g. 0-30)  (left hand side y-axis) but they have different SE(θ) scale (right hand side y-axis).  A reviewer asked me to change the plots so that they both have the same scale on the SE(θ). Is there a way to customise the scale of the SE(θ)? 

I would appreciate your input,
Best,
Nikos

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Changing the y-axis scale in TIF plots
parts:
Hi Nikolaos,

It is possible to save the plotting objects (e.g., obj <- plot(...)) and adjust the internal components such as $xlim and $ylim, though locating these elements can be a little cumbersome depending on the plot. In any case, replacing the element once you've found the associated range and then redrawing via print() should solve the problem. E.g., see https://groups.google.com/g/mirt-package/c/YRTUN6lO9EQ/m/u6NcCv0fBQAJ

Phil
